track_a_code_isolation_contract_refineme.source_install: Install both source anchors without allowing their package metadata to resolve different dependencies; use one explicit common environment.
track_a_code_isolation_contract_refineme.pandas: pin the same pandas<2 build on both sides; pandas==1.5.3 is a valid concrete candidate
track_a_code_isolation_contract_refineme.pyext: pin pyext==0.7 on both sides for strict package-closure symmetry under Python 3.10, even though the selected DeMix nine-benchmark modules do not directly import it
track_a_code_isolation_contract_refineme.reason_for_pyext_symmetry: OpenCompass 0.5.1 declares pyext while 0.5.2 removes it. Keeping it present in both Track A environments prevents presence/absence from becoming a second variable.
track_a_code_isolation_contract_refineme.result_parser: Use the role-local deterministic stdlib-csv v3 adapter, not DeMix's pandas positional parser, so pandas-version sensitivity in result parsing is not conflated with OpenCompass behavior.
track_a_code_isolation_contract_refineme.summary_writer: OpenCompass DefaultSummarizer formats/writes CSV with Python string/file operations and does not depend on pandas in the inspected 0.5.1 source path.
